description: Frontend sky-map chat panel: api wrapper, chat hook, SkyChat panel component with floating launcher, and threading the in-use lat/lon + current time from useSkyMap into every request. Depends on FEAT-001's POST /skymap/chat contract (SkyChatRequest {messages, latitude, longitude, time} -> SkyChatResponse {reply, visibility}). Only ADD to the sky-map feature; do NOT change any azimuth/coordinate/rendering code (eqVec, altAzLookTarget, horizon labels, scene builders) and do NOT re-prompt for geolocation. Grounded in design.md section 8 and verified against the constellation chat files + useSkyMap.js listed in context.json.
steps: Create celestia_fe/src/features/skymap/api.js exporting chatWithSky(messages, latitude, longitude, time) => request('/skymap/chat', { messages, latitude, longitude, time }), importing request from '../../services/apiClient' (mirrors celestia_fe/src/features/constellation/api.js).

Create celestia_fe/src/features/skymap/hooks/useSkyChat.js modeled on constellation/hooks/useChat.js: hold the transcript (seed an assistant greeting about the sky map), input, loading; on send append the user message, call chatWithSky(updatedMessages, lat, lon, new Date().toISOString()), append the assistant reply, and surface the response's visibility object to the component; accept lat/lon (and onClose) as arguments. Keep the Enter-to-send onKey handler.

Create celestia_fe/src/features/skymap/components/SkyChat.jsx styled to match constellation/components/ConstellationChat.jsx (panel background rgba(10,14,28,0.97), accent #4a90d9, lucide Sparkles/Send/X, same bubble/typing styles). Accept lat and lon props, use useSkyChat. Add a small floating launcher button (fixed, bottom-right) that opens the widget over the fullscreen canvas; the widget uses pointer-events only on itself so the map stays interactive behind it. When a response carries visibility.nextRiseUtc (state BELOW_RISES), any rise-time chip formats it via new Date(visibility.nextRiseUtc).toLocaleString() (browser's own IANA zone; no longitude offset guessing). The assistant reply text already phrases the 'in about N hours' delta.

Modify celestia_fe/src/features/skymap/hooks/useSkyMap.js: add const [coords, setCoords] = useState({ lat: 44.4, lon: 26.1 }); call setCoords({ lat, lon }) inside BOTH the geolocation success branch (using pos.coords.latitude/longitude) and the Bucharest fallback branch (44.4/26.1); return coords alongside the existing { mountRef, status, tooltip, conNamesRef }. Do NOT re-prompt for geolocation and do NOT touch any rendering/builder/astronomy code in the hook.

Modify celestia_fe/src/features/skymap/index.jsx: consume coords from useSkyMap and render <SkyChat lat={coords.lat} lon={coords.lon} /> alongside the existing canvas/status/tooltip, defaulting to Bucharest 44.4/26.1 if coords is somehow unavailable (never block on GPS).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` from app/Celestia/celestia_fe succeeds with the new api.js, useSkyChat.js, SkyChat.jsx and the modified useSkyMap.js/index.jsx.
The chat sends messages, latitude, longitude and time (current ISO instant) to POST /skymap/chat on every send, using the lat/lon actually in use (real GPS on success, else Bucharest 44.4/26.1).
No existing sky-map rendering/azimuth/coordinate code was changed and geolocation is not re-prompted.
verification: git -C app/Celestia/celestia_fe diff --stat -- src/features/skymap/hooks/useSkyMap.js  (expect only coords state + return added, no rendering lines changed)
findings:
Implemented and verified. `npm run build` from app/Celestia/celestia_fe succeeds (exit 0; only the pre-existing >500kB chunk-size advisory, unrelated to this change). Added files: src/features/skymap/api.js (chatWithSky(messages, latitude, longitude, time) -> request('/skymap/chat', {messages, latitude, longitude, time}), importing request from '../../services/apiClient'); src/features/skymap/hooks/useSkyChat.js (transcript with a seeded assistant greeting, input, loading, visibility state; send() appends the user message, calls chatWithSky(updated, lat, lon, new Date().toISOString()), appends res.reply, surfaces res.visibility (null-coalesced); Enter-to-send onKey; signature useSkyChat(lat, lon, onClose)); src/features/skymap/components/SkyChat.jsx (floating round launcher button fixed bottom-right that opens the panel; panel styled to match ConstellationChat.jsx — rgba(10,14,28,0.97) bg, accent #4a90d9, lucide Sparkles/Send/X, same bubble/typing styles; overlay wrapper uses pointer-events:none with pointer-events:auto only on the panel so the fullscreen map stays interactive behind it; a rise chip renders only when visibility.state === 'BELOW_RISES' && visibility.nextRiseUtc, formatted via new Date(visibility.nextRiseUtc).toLocaleString() in the browser's own zone).

Modified: src/features/skymap/hooks/useSkyMap.js — added const [coords, setCoords] = useState({ lat: 44.4, lon: 26.1 }); setCoords called in BOTH the geolocation success branch (pos.coords.latitude/longitude) and the Bucharest fallback branch (44.4/26.1); coords returned alongside the existing { mountRef, status, tooltip, conNamesRef }. No rendering/builder/astronomy code (eqVec, altAzLookTarget, horizon labels, scene builders) was changed and geolocation is not re-prompted (verified via git diff). src/features/skymap/index.jsx — consumes coords from useSkyMap and renders <SkyChat lat={lat} lon={lon} /> with lat/lon defaulting to Bucharest 44.4/26.1 if coords is somehow unavailable (coords?.lat ?? 44.4, coords?.lon ?? 26.1); never blocks on GPS.

Contract usage confirmed against FEAT-001 findings: every send POSTs { messages, latitude, longitude, time } where time = current ISO instant; response { reply, visibility } is handled, visibility may be null. Rise fields (nextRiseUtc) consumed only for state BELOW_RISES. Committed locally on the current branch; not pushed.
